text:
carmen: Rolling out latency-saver-v2 today. Will toggle feature flag latency-saver-v2-ff in us-west then mirror. Change window 3h. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-latency-saver :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary created cr-8010. t0 -> 1% in us-west. Dashboard: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-8010

diego: Watch triggers: p95 > baseline +120ms, 5xx spike >0.4%, or token throughput >35% -> pause and evaluate.

lin: rollback tag ready: tag=v1-pin-2026-03-21. Runbook with commands: `/ff set latency-saver-v2-ff 0%` and `/route-pin set default router v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-21`

carmen: rollout plan I'm applying:```
feature_flag: latency-saver-v2-ff
steps:
  - t0: 1%
  - t+10m: 5%  # hold 15m
  - t+40m: 30% # hold 30m
  - manual: 100%
triggers:
  p95_ms: 120
  error_pct: 0.4
  throughput_pct: 35
```

deploy-bot: t+12m metrics: p95 +15ms, errors nominal. Advancing to 5%

ops-bot: Noted slight token throughput increase on a small subset of shards (us-west-2c). Suggest AZ pin if sustained.

diego: If us-west-2c persists >20m I'll push AZ override: `/route override --az us-west-2c --pin v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-21`

lin: Also enabling cache-warmup for v2 now. infra command executed.

deploy-bot: 5% hold passed. Moving to 30% on approval.

carmen: Approve moving to 30% after 25m stable. Keep manual hold at 30m.

ops-bot: us-west-2c CPU returned to baseline after compaction job deferred. No AZ pin required now.

lin: Good. Proceeding to 30%. Command: `/ff roll latency-saver-v2-ff --region us-west --target 30 --hold 30m`

deploy-bot: Flag at 30% in us-west. Monitoring: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-8010/metrics

diego: All green so far. Manual approval required for 100%. Carmen, will you give final?

carmen: I'll sign off in 10m if metrics stay green and security-bot has no alerts.

security-bot: No new alerts for latency-saver-v2 in the last 2h.

deploy-bot: Holdpoint passed. Carmen approved. Rolling to 100% in us-west now.

lin: `/ff roll latency-saver-v2-ff --region us-west --target 100` executed. Canary cr-8010 closed success. Scheduling eu/apac rollouts with same holds. Release notes updated: https://go/release/2026-03-latency-saver#done

carmen: Nicely done. Follow-ups: keep v1-pin tag for 72h, monitor p95 and throughput for 24h, and add AZ-override examples to the runbook.
